description.html: Ahhhh-ten-tion! Your Military-Grade Testosterone Booster Is Reporting For Duty! This powerful formula has 16 effectively dosed ingredients created to give you exactly what you require to master your mission and conquer your goals! The standard for testosterone boosting has been raised - Experience The Difference! Benefits Helps Boost Testosterone* Helps Boost Nitric Oxide Levels* Helps Improve Overall Mood* Supports Increased Muscle Mass* Helps Boost Luteinizing Hormone (LH)* Helps Reduce Estrogen Levels* Helps Reduce Cortisol Levels* Helps Improve Recovery* Helps Improve Strength* Helps Boost Libido* Helps Block DHT* What's inside Sergeant Steel? D-Aspartic Acid: D-aspartic acid is an endogenous amino acid present in neuroendocrine tissues of invertebrates and vertebrates. DAA has shown to increase amount of testosterone released in the blood, increased testosterone leads to muscle growth. DAA also increases nitric oxide (NO2, NO3) production, promoting fast recovery after workouts. Studies have shown that D-Aspartic Acid can raise Testosterone levels by 42% after 12 days of consistent use. KSM-66® Ashwagandha Root Extract: Also known as Ashwagandha, this ingredient is an adaptogen which means it can assist in reducing anxiety. Also it has shown to improve semen quality by increasing serum levels of Testosterone and Luteinizing Hormone (LH), while reducing levels of Follicle Stimulating Hormone (FSH). Ashwagandha also helps to reduce levels of cortisol in the body, a hormone causes the loss of muscle and increases in fat. Mucuna Pruriens: This ingredient acts as a precursor to Dopimine. Dopimine is thought to be involved in the mental processes like motivation, mood, attention, memory, voluntary muscular movement, and learning. Also research suggests that L-Dopa supports lean muscle growth and normal hormone levels in men and women. Nettle Extract: Also known as Urtica Dioica, helps to inhibit Sex Hormone Binding Globulin (SHBG) indirectly helping to boost testosterone. Fenugreek: This ingredient has demonstrated a significant effect on aspects of libido and helps to maintain testosterone levels. Studies have shown that the seeds of the plant were able to increase testosterone levels, strength output, as well as hormonelevels while helping to reduce DHT. Shilajit: A nutrient and mineral rich biomass containing many medicinal humic and fulvic acids that has been praised for years for being the best carrier of energy and nutrition to the human body. Shilajit has been shown in recent studies to help increase both testosterone secretion and stimulation. LJ100: A patented extract developed at Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) for the treatment of sexual dysfunction and male fertility, also known as Tongkat Ali, it supports increased sex drive through multiple pathways, including through the influence of free testosterone sex hormone binding globulin (SHBG) and aromatase activity. SHBG is a protein which inhibits the circulation of your free testosterone by binding it up and making it unavailable - it also has been suggested to impact SHBG based on clinical studies. Studies have also shown it to have anti-aromatase properties similar to Formestane, which leads to decreased estrogen and increased testosterone. Dehydroabietic Acid (DHAA): Studies suggest that this strong ingredient has great anti-estrogen effects. It binds to the aromatase enzyme to help prevent the conversion of testosterone to estrogen. It also boosts the production of adiponectin, a protein hormone that supports weight loss. As a matter of fact, lowered levels of adiponectin correlate with obesity. Therefore, this ingredient may help enhance body composition while helping decrease estrogen. Tribulus Extract: The very commonly used testosterone boosting ingredient in which a recent study showed that this extract increased users testosterone levels by 12% and IGF-1 levels by 20%. Maca Extract: A member of the broccoli family that has been shown to assist and improve fertility through increased production of sperm. In addition, Maca helps to inhibit prostate growth by supporting decreased conversion of testosterone to DHT. Boron: An essential mineral required by the body for bone growth and also has been shown to help reduce SHBG levels therefore promoting increased testosterone levels. Answer the Call and Report for Duty with Sergeant Steel Now!! Source: www.muscleandfitness.com/supplements/build-muscle/top-10-testosterone-boosters-2020 As with any dietary supplement, we recommend that you consult a physician before use. These statements have not been evaluated by the Food and Drug Administration. This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease.

description.html: Muscle & Fitness 2019 #1 Pre Workout... Wild Thing is the Pre Workout you need to explode in the Gym! It is time to leave the crowd behind and Get Wild! Wild Thing contains a comprehensive formula with amino acids, creatine, mental enhancers, energy and pump ingredients that will have you crushing your personal records. NEW FLAVOR! STRAWBERRY MANGO RUSH! STOP trailing and START leading, evolve your pre-workout and benefit from what an advanced next generation supplement can do for you. Benefits: May help Increase Your Energy* May help Increase Your Focus* May help Increase Your Strength During Workouts* May help Increase Your Muscle Pumps* May help Increase Your Muscle Endurance* May help Improve Your Overall Mood* May help Accelerate Your Muscle Recovery* May help Decrease Your Muscle Fatigue* May help Increase Your Muscle Control* May help Improve Your Mental Cognition* What's Inside Wild Thing Preworkout: DiCitrulline Malate: Non-essential amino acid that assists in increase muscular energy and improves both anaerobic and aerobic activity, power, strength, increases nitric oxide production as well as helps to reduce fatigue and soreness following your training. Beta Alanine: Non-essential amino acid that assists to raise muscle carnosine concentrations which can then help to reduce muscle fatigue increasing the amount of work you can perform at high intensities. Agmatine Sulfate: Byproduct of Arginine, Agmatine is produced through a process called decarboxylation. This compound has gained much exposure in the supplement industry due to its ability to release enhancement hormone and its production of Nitric Oxide (N.O). L­-Glutamine: An amino acid naturally found in ones muscles and when supplemented promotes muscle growth, prevents muscle breakdown, and improve muscle recovery (anti-fatigue). Choline Bitartrate: Converts to Acetylcholine which is a neurotransmitter involved in many of your brain-body activities such as your memory, cognition, muscle control and reflexes. Caffeine Anhydrous: A pure and potent form of caffeine that makes it easier to achieve top training intensity. Caffeine also boosts thermogenesis, which causes your body to burn fat faster. L­-Tyrosine: Non-essential amino acid that helps to prevent the body from topping out while promoting smooth brain function, mood enhancement and lowering anxiety as a bonus. L-Norvaline: A form of the amino acid L-Valine that has been shown to positively affect the circulation of nitric oxide (N.O.) while assisting to heighten the production of your nitric oxide levels and as a nutrient delivery to muscles during and after workouts. Get WILD with Wild Thing and Have the Best Workout of Your Life!!
